sellerRegistration.title: Seller registration
sellerRegistration.description: Complete the steps to activate your store.
sellerRegistration.identityDescription: Upload clear photos of your identity document (front and back). This helps protect buyers and sellers.
sellerRegistration.successDescription: Your registration is complete. Your account verification is pending — meanwhile, you can shop and use your account normally.
sellerRegistration.bothDocumentsRequired: You must upload both sides of your identity document
sellerRegistration.draftSaved: Your progress was saved. Your identity documents are still pending for when you return.
sellerRegistration.draftSaveError: Your progress could not be saved
sellerRegistration.cancelSuccess: Seller registration cancelled. You are a regular user again.
sellerRegistration.destinationMarketHelp: Area where your customers will receive orders
sellerRegistration.paymentSetup: Set up your payment methods to receive customer payments.
